bricks.label: Game Starts
bricks.description: Fires once, the moment the level begins.

bricks.label: Scene Starts
bricks.description: Fires once, the moment this scene loads (same moment as Game Starts, on level 1).

bricks.label: Touched
bricks.description: Fires the moment the player touches this entity.

bricks.label: Bumped
bricks.description: Fires when the player bumps this entity from a specific direction — 'from: above' is the classic stomp.

bricks.label: Health Reaches 0
bricks.description: Fires the instant this entity's health hits zero.

bricks.label: Counter Reaches N
bricks.description: Fires when a named counter crosses the value you pick.

bricks.label: Item Collected
bricks.description: Fires whenever any Give Item brick runs — filter to one item, or leave blank for any.

bricks.label: Enemy Defeated
bricks.description: Fires whenever a Defeat Self brick removes an entity tagged 'enemy'.

bricks.label: Every N Seconds
bricks.description: Fires again and again, on a repeating timer — no loop brick needed.

bricks.label: Player Enters Zone
bricks.description: Fires the moment the player steps into this zone entity.

bricks.label: Player Leaves Zone
bricks.description: Fires the moment the player steps out of this zone entity.

bricks.label: Message Received
bricks.description: Fires when any Send Message brick broadcasts this exact name.

bricks.label: Has Item
bricks.description: True when the player is (or, with value off, is NOT) carrying at least one of this item.

bricks.label: Counter Compare
bricks.description: True when a named counter matches the comparison.

bricks.label: Chance
bricks.description: True this often, out of 100 — uses the level's seeded dice, so a saved replay always rolls the same way.

bricks.label: Facing
bricks.description: True when this entity is currently facing the chosen direction.

bricks.label: In Zone
bricks.description: True while this entity is standing inside any zone.

bricks.label: Health Compare
bricks.description: True when this entity's current health matches the comparison.

bricks.label: Patrol Between

params.name: relative
params.label: route is from where it stands

bricks.description: Start walking back and forth between two or more points, forever, until Stop. With 'route is from where it stands' on, the points are offsets from wherever this thing was placed, so two copies each patrol their own spot.

bricks.label: Follow Path
bricks.description: Walk through a list of points once, then stop at the last one.

bricks.label: Teleport To
bricks.description: Instantly move this entity to an exact spot.

bricks.label: Face
bricks.description: Turn this entity to face left or right, without moving it.

bricks.label: Stop
bricks.description: Cancel any Patrol Between or Follow Path this entity is currently doing.

bricks.label: Deal Damage
bricks.description: Take away health — from the player by default (a spike or enemy hurts whoever touches it), or from yourself if you set target to self.

bricks.label: Heal
bricks.description: Give back health, up to the maximum.

bricks.label: Knockback
bricks.description: Give a sudden shove in a direction.

bricks.label: Become Invincible
bricks.description: Ignore all damage for a little while.

bricks.label: Shoot
bricks.description: Fire a small projectile in the direction this entity is facing. Give the projectile its own bricksheet to decide what happens when it hits something.

bricks.label: Explode
bricks.description: Damage everything with health inside a radius, right now.

bricks.label: Defeat Self
bricks.description: Remove this entity from the level. If it's tagged 'enemy', this is what an Enemy Defeated brick is listening for.

bricks.label: Respawn At Checkpoint
bricks.description: Send this entity back to the last checkpoint (or the level start, if none has been set yet), and refill its health.

bricks.label: Spawn Prefab
bricks.description: Create a new copy of a saved prefab, right now.

bricks.label: Destroy Self
bricks.description: Remove this entity from the level (same effect as Defeat Self, but no 'enemy defeated' event — for scenery, not foes).

bricks.label: Show / Hide
bricks.description: Toggle whether this entity is visible, without removing it.

bricks.label: Send Message
bricks.description: Broadcast a named signal every bricksheet in the level can listen for.

bricks.label: Award Points
bricks.description: Add to a named counter (score, coins — whatever you call it).

bricks.label: Set Counter
bricks.description: Set a named counter to an exact value.

bricks.label: Give Item
bricks.description: Add to the player's inventory.

bricks.label: Take Item
bricks.description: Remove from the player's inventory.

bricks.label: End Game
bricks.description: End the level right now, win or lose.

bricks.label: Set Checkpoint
bricks.description: Save this entity's position as where the player respawns next.

bricks.label: Story Card Reached
bricks.description: Fires when a dialogue sequence reaches a specific card — leave blank to fire on any card.

bricks.label: Story Flag Set
bricks.description: True when a named story flag matches the value you pick.

bricks.label: Open
bricks.description: Open this entity — if it has a body, its collider turns off so the player can walk through.

bricks.label: Close
bricks.description: Close this entity — turns its collider back on, blocking the player again.

bricks.label: Swap Sprite
bricks.description: Change this entity's look — a new color, or a different Atelier sprite.

bricks.label: Play Animation
bricks.description: Show a specific flipbook frame from this entity's Atelier sprite.

bricks.label: Shake Camera
bricks.description: Give the camera a brief, decaying shake — great for impacts and explosions.

bricks.label: Lock Zone
bricks.description: Make a zone stop responding to the player entering or leaving it.

bricks.label: Unlock Zone
bricks.description: Let a locked zone start responding to the player again.

bricks.label: Play SFX
bricks.description: Play a sound made in the SFX Foundry. Turn on positional for a sound that pans left/right based on where it's coming from.

bricks.label: Play Song
bricks.description: Start a song made in the Sound Booth, looping until Stop Music.

bricks.label: Stop Music
bricks.description: Stop whatever song is currently playing.

bricks.label: Flash Channel
bricks.description: Briefly turn on a render channel (like bloom) for a flash effect, then turn it back off.

bricks.label: Slow Time
bricks.description: Slow the whole game down for a little while, then return to normal speed.

bricks.label: Say
bricks.description: Show a dialogue card — a speaker and a line of text.

bricks.label: Show Choice Card
bricks.description: Show a story card with buttons the player can pick between — where the story branches.

bricks.label: Set Story Flag
bricks.description: Remember something happened — check it later with Story Flag Set.

bricks.label: Key Pressed
bricks.description: Fires the instant a named action key is pressed — the action name matches whatever key mapping the game defines (shoot, dash, whatever you need).

bricks.label: Chase
bricks.description: Start smoothly chasing a target — name another entity to follow it live, or give a fixed x/y instead. Rides on real steering, not a straight line.

bricks.label: Flee
bricks.description: Start smoothly fleeing from a target, once it gets close enough to matter.

bricks.label: Wander
bricks.description: Start wandering — natural, meandering motion with no fixed target.

bricks.label: Path To
bricks.description: Find a real route around walls and obstacles to a target, then walk it — for mazes and dungeons where a straight line would walk into a wall.

bricks.label: Spawned
bricks.description: Fires once for this specific entity, the moment it comes into existence — whether it was placed in the Stage from the start, or created later by Spawn Prefab or Shoot. Use this instead of Game Starts for anything created mid-game, since Game Starts only ever fires once, before a later-spawned entity exists.

bricks.label: Emit Particles
bricks.description: Play a particle effect made in the Particle Lab, starting right where this entity is.
